title: Microledger Canvas for Message-Level Billing: interactive pivot, pricing preview, and export
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a composer-style UI (Microledger Canvas) in Redwood Console for exploring, slicing, and exporting message-level billing data. The canvas should let users pivot by role, route, model variant, time window, and prompt footprint, preview pricing for selected rows with pricing band overlays, and create reusable export templates (CSV/NDJSON). This ticket covers high-fidelity screens, interaction spec, export schema, and a short usability validation run.
goals: Allow finance & platform teams to generate role-aware per-message cost breakdowns without needing SQL
Provide preview of per-row pricing with clear breakdown of token, model, and infra charges
Support reusable export templates with canonical column mapping to billing ledger
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype demonstrating pivot + filter + preview workflows
Export schema documented and mapped to billing ledger fields (CSV and NDJSON examples)
Prototype tested with 6 participants (platform engineers, finance analyst, product manager) and top 3 usability issues addressed
API contract drafted for engineering to support aggregated per-message queries and export streaming
design_notes: Key interaction patterns: 1) left rail (dimensions) for quick pivoting; 2) central canvas table with inline pricing preview when hovering rows; 3) right rail for selected row details + pricing band visualization; 4) export builder modal that allows field selection, aggregation granularity, and schedule. Pricing preview must surface token-level details (prompt tokens, completion tokens), model surcharge, quantization/throughput adjustments, and infra uplift. We explored a compact sparkline + delta indicator for cost anomalies and a 'canonical columns' toggle to align with downstream billing ingestion. Performance heuristics: show sampled preview for large sets, provide async export job if row count > 100k.

testing_plan: Remote moderated sessions (6 participants) covering: build a role-aware slice, preview pricing for three sample rows, configure an export template, and initiate export. Capture time-on-task, errors, and qualitative feedback. Acceptance: median task completion < 3 minutes for primary workflows and no critical usability blockers.
implementation_notes: Engineering needs: 1) new aggregated per-message query endpoint with filter-by-dimensions, sampling option, and preview mode; 2) export streaming job endpoint producing compressible CSV/NDJSON with canonical columns; 3) front-end lazy-loading and sampled preview fallbacks for large result sets. Suggested API names: /v1/costs/aggregate-preview and /v1/costs/exports. See ENG-82419/82420 for backend tickets.
risks_and_mitigations: Large exports could overwhelm the UI/backend — implement async export job and estimated export size check
Canonicalizing columns could break customers' existing ingestion — provide both 'canonical' and 'raw' export modes and clear migration notes
Token-level attribution accuracy depends on upstream logs fidelity — add data quality warnings in the UI when retrospective coverage < 95%
